reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team to confirm I'd noted that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23.

I didn't save it to my persistent memory. Her message in #central-team already records it, where the channel's members can see it. Memory can come up in conversations with people outside that channel, so keeping it there could leak account details to them. Nothing else was needed.
